data.gender_notes: Ahid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ahid means 'gift from God' or 'gift of God'. This name is derived from the Arabic root word 'hadida', which means 'gift'. Ahid is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy in the Islamic tradition. The name Ahid carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahid usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Ahid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahid total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
